left.title: Kyrsten Sinema wins Arizona Senate race in breakthrough for Democrats
left.body: Sinema becomes state’s first female senator after a lengthy vote count in one of the most closely watched midterm races
left.roundup: After a tight contest, Democrat Kyrsten Sinema wins the Arizona Senate race and becomes the first female Senator from that state.

center.title: Democrat Kyrsten Sinema Wins Arizona Senate Race
center.body: After tight contest, the moderate is elected state’s first Democratic senator in 30 years
center.roundup: After a tight contest, Democrat Kyrsten Sinema wins the Arizona Senate race and becomes the first female Senator from that state.

right.title: Democrat Kyrsten Sinema wins Arizona Senate election as Martha McSally concedes
right.body: Democrats netted another Senate seat Monday night after Republican Martha McSally conceded Arizona’s race to Democrat Kyrsten Sinema.
right.roundup: After a tight contest, Democrat Kyrsten Sinema wins the Arizona Senate race and becomes the first female Senator from that state.
